New 2025 Gulf Stream BTouring Cruiser 5240 Features Auto Leveling Jacks E-450 Chassis Tire Package Upgrade 15K A/C Heated Holding Tanks Fantastic Fan Solid Surface Countertops Swivel Seat Heated Remote Mirrors Full Body Paint More About This RV With the low profile and 96 inch width of our agile BT Cruiser, you can indulge in two of life's great adventures: Camping in the great outdoors, and driving the highways and byways of North America. BT Cruiser floor plans concentrate on providing comfort, luxury, and adventure for a traveling couple, but still offer accommodations for children and guests. The beautiful motorhome is highlighted by the 'Touring Package' featuring Onan enclosed generator, power awning w/ LED lights, black appliance package, high gloss fiberglass exterior sidewalls, fiberglass roof, upgraded LED lighting in the interior & exterior, exterior acrylic grab handle, range cover, friction hinge entry door w/ shade, ducted roof air conditioner, ceiling light wall switch at entry door, fiberglass running boards, electric step, dual battery charging system, emergency start switch, deluxe comfort mattress, stainless steel wheel liners, outside shower, black tank flush, ladder, spare tire and carrier, second house battery, soft touch driver and passenger seats, frameless windows and much more.
